The '''Ord Trasi system''' was a [[star system]] located in the [[Relgim sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]], in grid square L-4 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The system was one of the endpoints of the [[Veragi Trade Route]]<ref name="Veragi" /> and was situated along the [[Braxant Run]].<ref name="Route" />
